ideas.idea: Replace the onClick div with a real link to /features
ideas.why: This restates a known problem (the /features onClick link), but it is accurate and specific. It is excluded as already graded.

ideas.idea: Name the actual integrations in the home page text instead of 'all the tools you already use'
ideas.why: The home page says 'Integrates with all the tools you already use.' and names none, so naming them gives people and machines concrete facts.

ideas.idea: Add plan names, contents and prices to /pricing instead of 'Talk to us for a quote'
ideas.why: The pricing page has almost no substance, and concrete plan details would help people and machines understand the offering.
The brief says having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, so recommending it goes against that.
This is accurate, since the sitemap has no lastmod, but it applies to almost any site and has little effect.

ideas.idea: Give each changelog release its own page or URL
ideas.why: The changelog is a single list, so per-release URLs would let people link to and cite a release.

ideas.idea: Add charset and viewport meta tags in root.tsx
ideas.why: This is accurate, since root.tsx sets neither, but it applies to nearly any site and does little for discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add Features to the nav in root.tsx
ideas.why: The nav lists only Pricing and Changelog, so a real link to Features in the nav fixes a specific discovery gap.

ideas.idea: Expand the Features page with a section on each of timelines, sharing and status updates
ideas.why: The page has only a one-sentence description, so more detail would help readers and machines understand the product.

ideas.idea: Improve the root fallback title and description to say what Atlas is
ideas.why: The title 'Atlas' is vague, but the fallback is overridden on most routes and only matters for /pricing, which is a known problem.

ideas.idea: Load changelog entries in a Remix loader
ideas.why: This restates the known useEffect problem, but it is accurate and specific. It is excluded as already graded.

ideas.idea: Disallow plus noindex on /dashboard: crawlers can't see the noindex
ideas.why: The report itself calls this deliberate and harmless, and it only mentions it for awareness, so it is not a real action.
